newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU may rule on TF1 complaint in April.
newsitem.headline: EU may rule on TF1 complaint in April.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to rule in April on a complaint by French private television broadcaster TF1 that public channels France 2 and France 3 are distorting fair competition, a Commission source said on Monday.

At issue is the financing of public broadcasters in France through both TV fees and commercials. TF1, which is controlled by building company Bouygues, argues that the two rival channels are using public money to cut advertising prices, the source said.
The Commission could rule at the same time on a similar fight opposing Mediaset of Italian media tycoon Silvio Berlusconi and RAI.

Last year, it found against Portuguese channel SIC which had also complained about the financing of public broadcaster RTP. The Commission said that RTP's analytical accounting clearly showed that subsidies paid by the state were limited to compensate for the general interest services it imposes on the Portuguese channel.

But the case of other European public TV broadcasters getting revenue from both commercials and the state will be less easy to defend, EU sources said, if only because their books are not as transparent as RTP's. -- Amelia Torres 322 2876841
